items.name: Hatchet
items.description: This small axe can be used in close combat or thrown.

items.name: Pick
items.description: A pick designed solely for combat has a sturdy wooden shaft and a heavy, pointed head to deliver devastating blows.

items.name: Hide Armor
items.description: A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

items.name: Climbing Kit (Extreme)
items.description:
This satchel includes 50 feet of rope, pulleys, a dozen pitons, a hammer, a grappling hook, and one set of crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5] whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall.

You gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb while using an extreme climbing kit. A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit. If you wear your climbing kit, you can access it as part of a Climb action.

items.name: Compass
items.description: A compass helps you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Sense Direction] or navigate, provided you're in a location with uniform magnetic fields. Without a compass, you take a -2 item penalty to these checks (similar to using a shoddy item).

items.name: Spyglass
items.description: A typical spyglass lets you see eight times farther than normal.

items.name: Survey Map
items.description: Maps are uncommon. Most maps you can find are simple and functional. A survey map details a single location in excellent detail. One of these maps gives you a +1 item bonus to Survival checks and any skill checks to Recall Knowledge, provided the checks are related to the location detailed on the map. The GM determines what maps are available in any location.

generalAbilities.name: Chasm Crossing
generalAbilities.description: The mountaineer Strides twice and Leaps up to 20 feet horizontally.

generalAbilities.name: Experienced Steps
generalAbilities.description: A mountaineer isn't impeded by difficult terrain caused by snow or ice. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Balance on slippery ice.

generalAbilities.name: Lost My Footing
generalAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The mountaineer critically fails a check to Balance or Climb

Effect Training kicks in, and the mountaineer catches themself, improving the check from a critical failure to a failure.

generalAbilities.name: Professional Climber
generalAbilities.description: While climbing, the mountaineer can have up to five allies Following the Expert and grants a +3 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Climb.

generalAbilities.name: Team Awareness
generalAbilities.description:
Requirements A creature is undetected by one or more of the mountaineer's allies but is observed by the mountaineer

Effect The mountaineer Points Out an enemy and makes a Strike against them.

defensiveAbilities.name: Tuck and Roll
defensiveAbilities.description: During an avalanche, the mountaineer gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Reflex save against bludgeoning damage and natural disasters.

offensiveAbilities.name: Arctic Passage
offensiveAbilities.description: The mountaineer ignores difficult terrain caused by ice or snow.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Draw
offensiveAbilities.description: The mountaineer Interacts to draw their hatchet or pick, then Strikes with the weapon.
